description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Left & Right Targa Vertical Pieces.
These are the Drivers Side (LH) and Passenger Side (RH) Uprights
Comes With Trim Garnish for Both Sides
Requires Garnish Trim Attachment Clips
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Targa Bar LH Vertical Panel
Qty 1 – Targa Bar RH Vertical Panel
Qty 2 – Trim Garnish
Qty 4 – Trip Clips
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
READ THIS: Condition Statement – “Metal Body Parts”
This listing is for Metal Body Parts. All Metal Body Parts will contain Minor Dings and Scrapes. Minor Dings and Scrapes are Considered Normal. These Parts Can Not be Painted Unless Professionally Prepared. Preparation Includes Cleaning, Sanding, Filling, Priming and Possibly Other Work Based on Final Use Requirements. Ask Questions before buying. Purchasing of this Part Constitutes Buyer’s Acknowledgement of Reading and Acceptance of the Above Condition Statement.
